irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_haste: Grants Haste to the struck creature. Each Amplify adds one spell level; Extend Time increases duration. AoE includes nearby creatures. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_slow: Slows the struck non-allied creature. Each Amplify adds one spell level; Extend Time increases duration. AoE includes nearby targets. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_blight: Blights the struck creature, reducing its damage and healing. Each Amplify adds one spell level; Extend Time increases duration. AoE includes nearby targets. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_guiding_b: Transforms projectiles into Guiding Bolts that damage and mark creatures. Each Amplify adds one spell level. Continues subsequent effects on impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lightning: Transforms projectiles into Lightning Lances. Each Amplify adds one spell level. Continues subsequent effects on impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_magic_arr: Transforms projectiles into Magic Arrows. Ordinary Projectile pierces creatures and blocks; other carriers retain their collision rules. Each Amplify adds one spell level. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_blood_nee: Transforms each projectile into one Blood Needle that damages creatures and steals life. Split adds projectiles; Amplify adds spell levels. Continues subsequent effects on impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.augment.area: Also affects visible creatures near the impact.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_firebolt: Transforms Projectile into a native Firebolt. Each Amplify adds one spell level. Continues subsequent effects on impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_icicle: Transforms projectiles into Icicles. Ordinary Projectile pierces creatures; other carriers retain their own piercing rules. Each Amplify adds one spell level. Continues subsequent effects on impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_magic_mis: Transforms Projectile into a native Magic Missile. Each Amplify adds one spell level. Continues subsequent effects on impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.augment.native_form: Changes the projectile's native form; subsequent effects run on impact.
irons_nouveau.augment.native_level: Starts at your highest personally crafted or upgraded scroll level. Amplify adds one level, Dampen removes one; minimum one. Creative starts at the native maximum.
irons_nouveau.validation.requires_form: Projectile needs a native form to use this augment.
irons_nouveau.validation.requires_projec: This form must augment a supported projectile or Orbit glyph.
irons_nouveau.validation.one_form: Choose only one native form per projectile.
irons_nouveau.validation.unsupported_mod: This native form does not yet support the selected augment.
irons_nouveau.validation.disabled: This spell form is currently unavailable.
irons_nouveau.cast.denied: You cannot use this spell yet.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_heal: Restores health to the struck creature. Amplify increases healing. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fortify: Grants Fortify to the struck creature. Amplify strengthens protection; Extend Time increases duration. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_oakskin: Grants Oakskin to the struck creature, reducing damage taken and movement speed. Amplify and Extend Time both increase duration. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_greater_h: Restores a large amount of health to the target. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_cleanse: Cleanses removable harmful effects from the target. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lightning: Calls lightning at the impact, damaging nearby enemies. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_chain_lig: Lightning jumps from the struck enemy to nearby enemies. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_healing_c: Creates a healing area at the impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_black_hol: Creates a black hole at the impact that pulls and damages nearby creatures. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_sculk_ten: Calls sculk tentacles around the impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_root: Roots the struck enemy. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_wisp: Calls an attacking wisp at the impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_firefly_s: Calls an attacking firefly swarm at the impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_thunderst: Periodically calls lightning against enemies around the target. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_summon_ve: Summons allied vexes near the impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_raise_dea: Raises allied undead near the impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_summon_ho: Summons a horse near the impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_summon_sw: Summons allied flying swords near the impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_summon_po: Summons an allied polar bear near the impact. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fireball: Transforms projectiles into explosive fireballs. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fire_arro: Transforms projectiles into explosive fire arrows. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_poison_ar: Transforms projectiles into arrows that leave poison clouds. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_magma_bom: Transforms projectiles into magma bombs that leave burning fields. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_snowball: Transforms projectiles into snowballs that leave frost fields. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_acid_orb: Transforms projectiles into acid orbs that weaken enemy armor. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_eldritch_: Strikes the target with eldritch energy. Costs mana when triggered; ongoing effects pay each round.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fire_brea: Breathes fire continuously, burning enemies ahead. Struck creatures emit the breath in their own direction; the caster pays its mana. Ends when its duration expires or mana is insufficient. Extend Time increases duration, each Amplify adds one spell level, and AoE enlarges it.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ray_of_si: Channels a life-draining ray. Self casts originate at your eyes; struck creatures emit from their eyes in their own direction; point triggers use the incoming direction. Damage and healing belong to the caster. Pays mana continuously until its duration expires or mana runs out. Extend Time increases duration and each Amplify adds one native level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_poison_br: Breathes poison continuously, poisoning enemies ahead. Struck creatures emit the breath in their own direction; the caster pays its mana. Ends when its duration expires or mana is insufficient. Extend Time increases duration, each Amplify adds one spell level, and AoE enlarges it.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_dragon_br: Breathes dragon energy continuously; hits may leave lingering pools. Struck creatures emit the breath in their own direction; the caster pays its mana. Ends when its duration expires or mana is insufficient. Extend Time increases duration, each Amplify adds one spell level, and AoE enlarges it.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_cone_of_c: Breathes freezing cold continuously against enemies ahead. Struck creatures emit the breath in their own direction; the caster pays its mana. Ends when its duration expires or mana is insufficient. Extend Time increases duration, each Amplify adds one spell level, and AoE enlarges it.
irons_nouveau.study.unfamiliar: You have not mastered this spell
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_heartstop: Applies Heartstop at the Ars target or impact. Uses your personally crafted scroll level and pays mana when triggered.

irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fang_ward: Applies Fang Ward at the Ars target or impact. Uses your personally crafted scroll level and pays mana when triggered.

irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_divine_sm: Applies Divine Smite at the Ars target or impact. Uses your personally crafted scroll level and pays mana when triggered.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_summon_en: Applies Summon Ender Chest at the Ars target or impact. Uses your personally crafted scroll level and pays mana when triggered.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_blood_sla: Applies Blood Slash at the Ars target or impact. Uses your personally crafted scroll level and pays mana when triggered.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lob_creep: Converts the projectile into an explosive creeper head and continues effects after impact. Pays mana when triggered.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_wither_sk: Applies Wither Skull at the Ars target or impact. Uses your personally crafted scroll level and pays mana when triggered.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_starfall: Rains comets around the trigger position, paying mana for each burst. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_arrow_vol: Fires successive rows of arrows above the trigger position, paying per row. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_chain_cre: Creates a creeper ring at the trigger position; rings chained by kills also cost mana. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fang_swir: Creates rotating lines of fangs at the trigger position, paying per wave. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_blaze_sto: Repeatedly fires small fireballs from the trigger position. An entity recipient supplies position and facing. Pays per shot. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_flaming_b: Replaces each projectile with a homing small fireball. Split or repeated Ars triggers produce further shots. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_cloud_of_: Repeatedly heals friendly creatures around the trigger position. Follows an entity recipient and pays per healing round. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ball_ligh: Replaces projectiles with ball lightning. Standard Projectile retains native bouncing and repeat damage; subsequent damage rounds cost mana. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_flaming_s: Slashes forward at the trigger position, using the original caster’s spell power and weapon damage. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_raise_hel: Creates one expanding ground eruption at the trigger position. Trigger again for another eruption. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ice_spike: Raises a forward line of ice spikes along the ground from the trigger position. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_firecrack: Detonates a native firework at the trigger position. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_spectral_: Swings a spectral hammer at a mineable block. Requires a player caster and respects block-break protection. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_touch_dig: Mines the struck block with the caster’s held-tool loot rules. Requires a player caster and respects block-break protection. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_shadow_sl: Entity targets only: the recipient performs Shadow Slash in its own facing direction. Self selects the caster; damage belongs to the original caster. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_burning_d: Entity targets only: the recipient performs Burning Dash in its own facing direction. Self selects the caster; contact damage belongs to the original caster. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ascension: Entity targets only: the recipient ascends with a lightning strike. Self selects the caster; damage belongs to the original caster. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_volt_stri: Entity targets only: the recipient performs Volt Strike in its own facing direction. Self selects the caster; contact and burst damage belong to the original caster. Each Amplify adds one spell level.
irons_nouveau.bound_weapon.invalid_sourc: Hold the destination item in your main hand and a readable spellbook in your off hand.
irons_nouveau.bound_weapon.bound: Bound the selected spell to your main-hand item.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ray_of_fr: Fires a single freezing ray. Entity triggers emit from the struck creature’s eyes in its facing direction; point triggers use the incoming direction. Blocks stop the ray. Each Amplify adds one native level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_electrocu: Channels branching lightning ahead. Struck creatures emit in their own direction; point triggers use the incoming direction. The caster pays ongoing mana until the duration ends or mana runs out. Extend Time increases duration, each Amplify adds one native level, and AoE enlarges the lightning.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_sunbeam: Calls down a pillar of sunlight at the trigger position after a brief windup. Pays once on activation; the delayed impact does not cost additional mana. Each Amplify adds one native level.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_blood_ste: Teleport the original caster beside a selected living entity and briefly become invisible. Requires a safe destination; self and block targets do nothing.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_frost_ste: Teleport the original caster beside a selected living entity, leaving a native frozen decoy at the origin. Requires a safe destination.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_telekines: Hold a selected living entity along the original caster's live aim using native telekinesis. Runs for a fixed duration, paying mana every half second; a new controller replaces the old one.
irons_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_arcane_sh: Replace an Ars projectile with a native Arcane Shackle projectile. Entity or block impacts create breakable native chains and continue the remaining Ars effects.
